nodes.name: Issuer type
nodes.question: Who, if anyone, creates and makes commitments regarding the token?

nodes.name: Centralisation level
nodes.question: Are governance, minting, yield and redemption controlled by a single entity or dispersed across the network?

nodes.name: Asset economic function
nodes.question: What is the economic, governance or rights-based purpose of the token?

nodes.name: Reference asset (stabilisation target)
nodes.question: What value, asset or basket, if any, does the token purport to maintain stable value against or redeem into?

nodes.name: Redemption mechanism
nodes.question: How does a holder convert the token back into its reference asset, and who controls that process?

nodes.name: Yield source
nodes.question: What economic activity or protocol mechanism generates the income a holder receives?

nodes.name: Yield distribution mechanism
nodes.question: How is yield delivered to holders: by changing balance, redemption ratio, price, or a separate asset?

nodes.name: Legal classification
nodes.question: Under which legal or regulatory category does the crypto-asset or activity fall?

nodes.name: Technical standard
nodes.question: Which technical template or token standard defines how the crypto-asset is issued and transferred?

nodes.name: Consensus mechanism
nodes.question: How do DLT network nodes agree that a transaction or block is validated?

nodes.name: Ledger access and permissioning
nodes.question: Who may read, write, validate or manage consensus on the distributed ledger (public, permissioned, private)?

nodes.name: Ledger governance model
nodes.question: Who sets, maintains or can change the rules of the blockchain system (decentralised, company, consortium, controlled)?

nodes.name: Custody arrangement
nodes.question: Who holds and controls the cryptographic keys or assets: the user, a custodian, or a multi-party scheme?

nodes.name: Wallet connectivity (hot vs cold)
nodes.question: Is the wallet's key storage connected to the internet or kept offline?

nodes.name: Private key control scheme
nodes.question: How is authority over a private key or wallet assets divided among one or more parties?

nodes.name: Crypto-asset / VASP service activity type
nodes.question: Which regulated crypto-asset service or VASP activity does the actor perform for others?

nodes.name: VASP / service provider status and authorisation
nodes.question: Is the entity a regulated VASP or service provider, and is it licensed, registered or exempt?

nodes.name: Money transmission / MSB status
nodes.question: Does the activity or actor constitute money transmission, making it a money transmitter or MSB?

nodes.name: Transaction intermediation mode (P2P vs intermediated)
nodes.question: Does the transfer occur peer-to-peer or through a regulated intermediary or self-hosted address?

nodes.name: Fungibility / uniqueness
nodes.question: Is the token fungible and interchangeable unit-for-unit, or unique and non-fungible?

nodes.name: Transaction anonymity feature
nodes.question: Does the token or transaction include built-in features that conceal transfer information?

nodes.name: Stablecoin status
nodes.question: Does the token seek or purport to maintain a stable value relative to a reference?

nodes.name: Reserve backing and redemption risk
nodes.question: What reserve assets back the token, and do they suffice to redeem at peg value under stress?

nodes.name: Form of claim (in personam / in rem)
nodes.question: What is the holder's legal right — contractual against an issuer or reserve, property-type in rem, or none — and who gets the proceeds?

nodes.name: TradFi analogy
nodes.question: Which traditional financial instrument does the token most resemble for regulatory mapping?

nodes.name: Staking participation role
nodes.question: What role does a participant take in staking or validation (self-run validator, delegator, staking-as-a-service, liquid staking)?

nodes.name: Validator selection and decentralisation of validation
nodes.question: How are validators selected and how distributed is the validator set?

nodes.name: Network topology and communication
nodes.question: How are nodes interconnected and how does information propagate across them?

nodes.name: Ledger data structure
nodes.question: How is the distributed ledger organised: chain of blocks, distributed non-block form, or other?

nodes.name: Ledger system component and layer
nodes.question: Which component of the DLT system (protocol, application, Layer 1/2, DeFi stack layer) is referred to?

nodes.name: Ledger replication (complete vs partial)
nodes.question: Do nodes hold complete or partial replicas of the ledger?

nodes.name: Smart contract / automated execution
nodes.question: Is the transaction or application executed automatically by code, and how expressive is the scripting language?

nodes.name: Cryptographic basis and agility
nodes.question: What cryptography underpins the asset or system, and can algorithms be migrated?

nodes.name: DLT / cryptographic asset basis
nodes.question: Does the asset rely on cryptography and distributed ledger technology, or on another technology?

nodes.name: Transaction fee and validator reward model
nodes.question: How are transaction fees and validator rewards structured?

nodes.name: Asset supply policy
nodes.question: How is the quantity of the asset created and bounded over time?

nodes.name: Native coin versus token
nodes.question: Does the asset run on its own blockchain (coin) or on an existing one (token)?

nodes.name: Underlying asset class of tokenised instruments
nodes.question: What kind of underlying asset or right does the token represent?

nodes.name: Prudential classification group
nodes.question: What prudential treatment group applies to a bank's cryptoasset exposure?

nodes.name: Identity and KYC layer
nodes.question: How are participants identified on the network and are AML/KYC procedures applied?

nodes.name: Beneficial ownership and control
nodes.question: Who ultimately owns or controls a legal entity or arrangement?

nodes.name: Illicit finance risk typology
nodes.question: Which category of ML, TF, PF, sanctions or fraud risk does a VA activity relate to?

nodes.name: AML/CFT preventive obligation scope
nodes.question: Which AML/CFT preventive obligations (CDD thresholds, travel rule, obliged-entity status) apply?

nodes.name: Issuer freeze and burn capability
nodes.question: Can the issuer block, freeze, seize or burn tokens on authorities' request?

nodes.name: Regulated entity status (service entities)
nodes.question: Are entities performing redemption, transfer, storage or settlement regulated and supervised?

nodes.name: Payment stablecoin regime and issuer form
nodes.question: What statutory status and legal form does a payment stablecoin issuer hold, and does it meet exemption criteria?

nodes.name: Offer, admission and disclosure
nodes.question: Is the token offered to the public, and does the offer require a white paper or disclosure?

nodes.name: Consumer and market risk category
nodes.question: Which consumer or market risk (custody, fraud, cybersecurity, privacy, operational) does an ecosystem feature expose holders to?

nodes.name: ICT incident severity and operational resilience
nodes.question: How severe is an ICT incident or cyber threat, and does it breach the major or critical threshold?

nodes.name: ICT risk source and third-party dependence
nodes.question: What kind of ICT risk, third-party dependency, or concentration risk is involved, and does it affect a critical function?

nodes.name: Settlement finality and enforceability
nodes.question: Are transfers and redemptions legally enforceable and final at a defined point?

nodes.name: Trading venue architecture
nodes.question: How is the trading venue organised (order-book, brokerage, kiosk, DEX, escrow)?

nodes.name: Control over transfer and ownership
nodes.question: Who has unilateral control of the asset and does the transfer change control?

nodes.name: Digital asset definitional scope
nodes.question: Does the digital representation fall within the defined class of digital or crypto-assets?

nodes.name: Transaction traceability
nodes.question: Are transactions and participants traceable on the network?

nodes.name: Slashing of staked collateral
nodes.question: Is a validator's staked collateral forfeited for misbehaviour?

nodes.name: Decentralised governance system status
nodes.question: Is the governing actor a decentralised governance system excluded from issuer or affiliate treatment?

nodes.name: Legal form of governance entity
nodes.question: Under what legal form does a decentralised governance entity operate?

nodes.name: Wallet owner type
nodes.question: Is the wallet owner a user, an agent of the host, or a financial institution?

nodes.name: Principal or agent capacity
nodes.question: Does the provider trade on its own account or for a client?

nodes.name: Digital commodity classification
nodes.question: Is the asset a digital commodity linked to a blockchain system, or another digital asset?

nodes.name: End user distribution status
nodes.question: Is the distribution broad and tied to network operation (end user distribution)?

nodes.name: Network token value source
nodes.question: Is the token's market value primarily derived from the distributed ledger system and its adoption, or from another source?

nodes.name: Stabilisation mechanism
nodes.question: How does a stablecoin defend its peg value?

nodes.name: Currency substitution (CVC status)
nodes.question: Does the virtual currency act as, or have equivalent value to, currency?

nodes.name: Token business and collateral structure
nodes.question: What regulatory obligations (custody, capitalisation, licensing) and risks follow from the classification of the asset?

nodes.name: Howey investment contract elements
nodes.question: Which elements of the Howey test (investment of money, common enterprise, expectation of profits, reliance on others' efforts) does an asset satisfy?

nodes.name: Digital asset service activity type
nodes.question: Which regulated activity does a digital asset service provider perform?

nodes.name: Relationship of holder to ancillary asset originator (related person)
nodes.question: Does a person have an insider relationship (founder, officer, large holder) with the ancillary asset originator or asset?

nodes.name: Basis of legal classification (economic function and rights)
nodes.question: What economic function and rights determine how the asset is classified?

nodes.name: Private key control scheme
nodes.question: How is authority over a wallet's private key divided among one or more parties?

nodes.name: Purpose of a transaction (payment, trading, or validation)
nodes.question: Is the crypto-asset activity carried on as a regular business dealing, a payment, or infrastructure participation?

nodes.name: Redemption right and redeemer
nodes.question: Who may redeem a stabilised cryptoasset for the traditional asset, and under what obligations?

nodes.name: Wallet technology form (software, hardware, mobile)
nodes.question: What technological form does the wallet take and how is value stored locally or externally?

nodes.name: Interoperability mode
nodes.question: How, if at all, can a blockchain exchange information with systems outside itself or with other blockchains?

nodes.name: Cross-chain bridge / connection model
nodes.question: What mechanism is used to connect a blockchain with other blockchains when it lacks native intraoperability?

nodes.name: Reporting cryptoasset service provider status
nodes.question: Is the provider subject to tax reporting and due diligence obligations in the UK, and is it exempt?

nodes.name: Money transmitter / MSB status
nodes.question: Does the activity constitute money transmission under the BSA, making the actor a money services business?

nodes.name: Critical resource control subdimension
nodes.question: Which specific control points (rule change, minting, reserves, rewards, distribution, exchange listing, transparency) are held by whom?

nodes.name: Application control status (DApp / DeFi)
nodes.question: Is a software application controlled by an identifiable administrator or operated without one?

nodes.name: Crypto-asset categories (token type)
nodes.question: What kind of crypto-asset is it, in terms of its function or the form in which it is distributed?
